name: 10850-specdecode-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B (target) + NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B (draft). Ungated mirrors of the Meta checkpoints: same weights, not substitutions.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, target and draft alike -- the draft inherits the target's degree when none is set. One in-process engine.
architecture: Both are dense LlamaForCausalLM, 8.03B, bf16, 16.1 GB of weights each; the vocabs are EQUAL (128256), which the draft-model speculative path requires.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 10%, bounded at 512 requests / 1800 s safety.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, FIXED SHAPE: exactly 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 128 output tokens, zero variance. Sampling is pinned: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k -1, repetition_penalty 1.0. `request_format: plain` sends raw text with no chat template, and the fixed output length makes the backend force ignore_eos.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter text assistant with a small draft model, serving eight concurrent users fixed-length completions on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine: source checkout at 9323a3153b20d4a2ca7ac04a2784609d6ce656e0. The interpreter is named
# by configs/env.yaml.

# Target. Base checkpoint, not -Instruct: the workload is completion.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B

# Draft. Same architecture as the target and the SAME vocab (128256 == 128256), which the
# draft-model speculative path requires; its own 131072-token window is capped to the target's
# 8192 by the engine.
speculative-model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B

# Drafted tokens per speculation round. A declared operating point, not a tunable.
num-speculative-tokens: 3

# One card. `speculative-draft-tensor-parallel-size` is deliberately unset, so the draft
# resolves to the target's degree.
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Both checkpoints' own "torch_dtype", pinned so a future default cannot drift it.
dtype: bfloat16

# Everything else is left at the pinned engine's own defaults.
#
# HAZARD: leave VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND UNSET. On H100 with bf16 and a decode-only batch the engine
# selects FlashAttention on its own; forcing XFORMERS changes how the draft's forward passes are
# executed and therefore changes the setup, not just its speed.
